# Agenda Intelligence MD

Product entry point and evidence-discipline layer for strategic intelligence agents. One MCP server with structured request/memo contract, geography-routed reasoning, schema validation, evidence audit, and scoring. Reasoning content is bundled from sibling repos (Global Think Tank Analyst as the method; Central Asia + Caspian and Gulf + Middle East as regional specialists, activated automatically when query geography matches). No live retrieval, no factual verification — both are explicit non-goals before v1.0.

Product MCP tools:
- analyze — accepts an AgendaRequest (schemas/v1/agenda-request.schema.json), routes geography to bundled regional references, assembles a system prompt from the Global Think Tank Analyst method plus matched regional lenses, optionally calls the Anthropic API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, and returns a memo validated against schemas/v1/agenda-memo.schema.json.
- validate_memo — validates a third-party memo against agenda-memo.schema.json and returns errors plus a score where implemented.
- list_signals / get_signal — read access to the vendored Global Think Tank Analyst signal archive.
- deep_dive — reserved stub; returns a v2 placeholder pointing callers at `analyze` with depth: scenario or red_team.
- middle_corridor_deal_risk — Kazakhstan / Middle Corridor deal-risk gate; structured deal_risk_request (middle-corridor-deal-risk-request.schema.json) in, triage recommendation + decision-readiness + evidence gaps out. Pre-compliance triage; human review required.
- cis_secondary_sanctions_exposure — CIS counterparty secondary-sanctions exposure triage (cis-secondary-sanctions-request.schema.json) for EU/UK/UAE/Singapore EDD. Local stdio runs on user-supplied evidence only; a name match is not identity verification.
- agentic_interaction_trust — trust-evidence triage for an agent-mediated interaction (agentic-interaction-trust-request.schema.json) before a high-stakes action. Evidence triage only; human review required.
- gulf_maritime_exposure — maritime sanctions + chokepoint-disruption exposure triage (gulf-maritime-exposure-request.schema.json) for a vessel/voyage transiting Strait of Hormuz / Persian-Arabian Gulf / Gulf of Oman / Bab-el-Mandeb / Red Sea. No live retrieval; does not resolve vessel ownership or verify identity; human review required.

Vertical worker on HTTP + A2A (no MCP stdio tool):
- kazakhstan_market_entry_readiness — Kazakhstan market-entry readiness gate (market-entry-readiness-request.schema.json + market-entry-readiness-response.schema.json) for distribution / import / service / showroom / EPC / renewable-energy / infrastructure / technology-transfer / partner-entry files; company + project + Kazakhstan objective + counterparties + supplied sources in, gate decision + readiness label + evidence gaps + claim audit + owner actions + watch-next out. Service function + HTTP POST /v1/market-entry/readiness + A2A profile; deployed Cloudflare Worker live at https://kazakhstan-market-entry-readiness-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev. Source taxonomy: source-requirements/kazakhstan-market-entry-readiness.json; use-case doc: docs/use-cases/kazakhstan-market-entry-readiness.md; contract examples: examples/kazakhstan-market-entry-readiness/contract/. Evidence triage only; not legal, tax, IP, data-compliance, customs, or sanctions advice; human review required.

Commercial discovery wedge:
- AI vendor evidence-readiness for regulated procurement is build-to-learn only, not product-market fit. Start with docs/discovery/ai-vendor-evidence-readiness-profile-pack-v0.1-2026-06-28.md and docs/templates/ai-vendor-evidence-readiness-profile.md.
- Public profiles should be crawlable, claim-addressable evidence packets: source IDs, buyer questions, vendor/system claims, missing evidence, owner actions, readiness decision, boundary notes, and follow-up signal. Retrieval discipline: docs/discovery/ai-retrievable-evidence-profiles-2026-06-29.md.
- Agent-readable concept map: okf/index.md, entitymap.json, and docs/agent-entity-map.md. Live worker copies are available at https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev/okf/index.md and https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev/entitymap.json. Use these to understand core concepts before interpreting vertical workers.
- Agentic Resource Discovery catalog: .well-known/ai-catalog.json, live at https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev/.well-known/ai-catalog.json. Worker API catalog and OpenAPI are live at https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev/.well-known/api-catalog and https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev/api/openapi.json. These advertise capabilities/resources, not buyer traction.
- Confidential project-room workflow: docs/trust/confidential-project-workflow.md plus the live public contract at https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev/profiles/confidential-project-room and synthetic redacted example at https://agenda-intelligence-a2a.vassiliy-lakhonin.workers.dev/profiles/confidential-project-room/redacted-example.json. Use aliases and source IDs; never expose client names or private source text in public artifacts.
- Success is buyer behavior: redacted file, second profile request, paid concierge review interest, budget-owner intro, or concrete workflow correction. Traffic, citations, likes, and "interesting" feedback are not traction.

Geography routing terms (lowercased substring match against question, decision_context, geography). Modules union, not exclusive. Authoritative source: src/agenda_intelligence/product.py. Guard: tests/test_product_shell.py::test_routing_terms_documented_in_canon.

global-think-tank-analyst: always loaded as the core reasoning method.

central-asia-caspian (CA_CASPIAN_TERMS):
almaty, azerbaijan, baku, caspian, central asia, georgia, kazakhstan, kyrgyzstan, middle corridor, tajikistan, tashkent, tcita, tcitr, turkmenistan, uzbekistan.

gulf-middle-east (GULF_ME_TERMS):
arabian gulf, bab el mandeb, bab-el-mandeb, bahrain, gcc, gulf, hormuz, iran, iraq, ksa, kuwait, levant, middle east, oman, persian gulf, qatar, red sea, saudi arabia, strait of hormuz, uae, united arab emirates, yemen.

eu (EU_TERMS; plus exact-token geography match against EU/Europe):
brussels, cbam, cjeu, ecb, eu ai act, eu enforcement, eu regulation, european central bank, european commission, european council, european parliament, european union, gdpr, nis2, schrems.

sanctions (SANCTIONS_TERMS, sector module):
entity list, export control, export controls, ofac, sanctions, secondary sanctions.

Core rule: do not summarize the news. Identify what changed, who is affected, what incentives shifted, what remains unknown, and what to watch next.

Repository: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/Agenda-Intelligence-md
Skill path: skills/agenda-intelligence/SKILL.md

Recommended use:
- policy and geopolitical analysis;
- sanctions and compliance monitoring;
- trade and regulatory risk briefs;
- founder/investor operating-context notes;
- red-team checks on confident narratives.

Related full memo skill: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/global-think-tank-analyst
Use Agenda-Intelligence.md for lightweight agenda triage; use global-think-tank-analyst for full policy-risk memos.

Regional lens packs:
- Central Asia + Caspian: skills/agenda-intelligence/references/regional/central-asia-caspian.md
- Middle East: skills/agenda-intelligence/references/regional/middle-east.md
- European Union: skills/agenda-intelligence/references/regional/eu.md

Top-level protocol: Agenda-Intelligence.md
Role: sits beside files such as AGENTS.md as a conditional public-agenda reasoning layer.
Use it only for news, policy, regulation, sanctions, geopolitics, trade, markets, conflict, or strategic-risk analysis.

Source Planning Layer:
- SOURCE_POLICY.md
- source-taxonomy.json
- source-requirements/*.json
CLI source/eval commands: start, source-categories, source-plan, source-coverage, validate-evidence, audit-claims, verify-quotes, score, bench, doctor, mcp-config

Boundary:
- Source-plan coverage is diagnostic before v1.0.
- Missing `must_check` coverage should be disclosed as an evidence gap, not treated as factual truth.
- These tools do not discover sources, score source reputation, or decide whether claims are true in the world.
